title: Merkle Airdrop-Proof Verifier
description: Recomputes a Merkle airdrop-claim proof from caller-declared leaf fields (address, uint256 amount, encoding_variant) and a sibling path, OpenZeppelin MerkleProof.verify shape (processProof/_hashPair) over the already-vendored @noble/hashes keccak256 bundle -- no new vendoring, no hand-rolled hashing. Leaf derivation follows OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree's (address,uint256) convention: encoding_variant selects the double-hash leaf (the second-preimage-resistant default) or a single-hash variant some deployed contracts use instead, always a declared param. Sibling-pair hashing is sorted/commutative (pair_sort:true, OpenZeppelin's default) or explicit per-step left/right position (pair_sort:false), also a declared param. Given an optional claimed_path (a prior run's per-step running hashes), re-verifies and reports the earliest step at which the recompute diverges, instead of only a final match/no-match. This node never reads any chain: it cannot know whether claimed_root is the root actually recorded on-chain, whether the leaf's allocation was already claimed or redeemed, or whether the underlying tree was built correctly from the full allocation list.

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte (40 hex char) EVM address, the airdrop claim leaf's account field.

amount.description: Non-negative uint256 token amount, as a decimal or 0x-hex string (never a JS number, to avoid precision loss above 2^53).

encoding_variant.description: 'double-hash' (default, OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree convention: keccak256(keccak256(abi.encode(address,amount)))) or 'single-hash' (keccak256(abi.encode(address,amount)) with no outer hash).

pair_sort.description: true (default) uses OpenZeppelin's commutative sorted-pair _hashPair; false requires each proof step to declare an explicit left/right position.

proof.description: Sibling path from leaf to root. Empty array means the leaf is the root (depth 0). Each entry is either a 0x-prefixed 32-byte hash string (pair_sort:true) or {sibling, position} (pair_sort:false).

claimed_root.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte (64 hex char) hash this proof is claimed to reconstruct.

claimed_path.description: Optional. A prior run's per-step running_hash values (as previously returned in output_payload.path) to re-verify against a possibly-altered leaf/proof -- used to detect the earliest divergent step.

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_merkle_airdrop_proof
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes a Merkle airdrop-claim proof from a declared leaf (address, amount) and sibling path to a claimed root, OpenZeppelin MerkleProof.verify shape, and optionally re-verifies a prior proof trace to report the earliest step where a recompute diverges.
